counterfactual_missing_items: description of tumor cells infiltrating surrounding tissues
evidence of tumor cells in lymphatic vessels
decisive_items: polygonal to short spindle-shaped cells formed small nests and sheets within dilated sinusoids without encapsulation
The tumor cells exhibited clear cell borders, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, hyperchromatic nuclei, frequent mitotic figures, and sparse hepatocellular necrosis
response.rationale: R3 is preferred due to more specific histological descriptions consistent with hepatocellular carcinoma, such as high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and frequent mitotic figures, which are characteristic of malignant processes.

rejected.why: less specific diagnosis of Hepatic Neoplasia without clear indication of malignancy
